+++
id    = "thm-gsp4-lift-automorphy"
kind  = "theorem"
title = "Automorphy of symplectic lifts in the cases of rank four"
lean  = ["UpperTheory.V.HV.DescentVanishingReductions.sp4In0_alt"]
order = 12
+++
Fix an auxiliary pair for a primitive character with its $\psi$-fields, large
for $t$, an odd prime $l$, $0 < e < t$ and an even character $\chi$ of
$\Gal(E/\Q)$ in the second or third case of the proof of
[thm-sha-bound]. Let $\bar\rho$ be a residual
representation $G_\Q \to \mathrm{GSp}_4$ of the kind attached to
$(l, e, \chi)$ there. Then:

* the ring generated by the traces of lifts of $\bar\rho$ of the prescribed
  type is finite over the coefficient ring;
* no such lift has block-diagonal image spanning the full block algebra;
* every irreducible lift of the prescribed type is automorphic over $\Q$.

*We read* the residual representations as the reducible representations
built from $\chi$ and powers of $\epsilon$ whose irreducible lifts, by
Ribet's method, produce the Selmer classes to be bounded.
